response.rationale: The order is still in_transit and has not been delivered (days_since_delivery is null), so the standard return window has not started. No return can be processed for an item that hasn't been delivered yet. Final-sale (RET-012), defective (RET-020), goodwill (RET-050), and fraud-hold (RET-051) rules do not apply on these facts, and the standard-window rules (RET-007/RET-008) cannot be satisfied without a delivery date.
